digest.component_or_area: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite verification / LLM-Review code-review gate
propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify fails on bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 with HTTP 400 ValidationException ('Grammar compilation timed out' or 'Schema is too complex') after ~180-185s, always with requests=0, degrading every finding to no-verification.

The 18ae exact-model-id row setting native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6 routes verification contracts (22-36 optional parameters) through NativeOutput, sending their JSON Schema to Bedrock for grammar compilation, which exceeds Anthropic's documented 180s timeout and internal complexity limits.

The Gerrit LLM-Review code-review gate's code_review_verification contract (36 optionals) fails identically when pinned to model=standard (resolving to sonnet-4-6), with the same 185.4s 400 response and requests=0 signature.

Two botocore-dependent rejection variants hit the same root cause: variant A (botocore >=1.43.64) hits server-side at 180-185s with 'Grammar compilation timed out', variant B (botocore 1.40.61) hits client-side in 0.0s with 'Unknown parameter in input: outputConfig', both caused by native structured-output support not actually available.

output_mode must gate NativeOutput on both (a) runtime stack support for outputConfig and (b) schema complexity (optional parameter and union-type counts), with complexity recursively descending $defs/items/nested properties, falling back to PromptedOutput when either constraint fails.
The remedy must classify schema-complexity rejections distinctly (not as generic outage), log loudly at WARNING on fallback, and never silently retry the failing constrained request.
